Only 4 in that set (plus ux/Menu's, which lives in a .js template string so *.css misses it) are popover-shaped triggers a top-layer popup could retire: core/Search's omnibox overlay, ext/drawer, ext/Panel's floating text toolbar, ux/Menu's panel. log.msg: Real bug caught live in the New-version proof: clicking the action wrote v/4/page.js and v/4/v4.css correctly, updated ai/v/page.js's children to "2 3 4" correctly (verified on disk both times), but the location.assign() navigation to /framework/ai/v/4/ landed on the app's own 404 ("nothing matches") once. Cause: the second write touches a file the server's directory watcher reacts to (rebuilds directory.json, broadcasts changed to the same tab) - Socket write()'s self-mute only covers the exact path written, not that derived ripple, so a real live-reload raced the navigation. Fixed in new.js with window.$BLOCKRELOAD = true before the writes (the site's own established escape hatch, ext/Ask/edit.js neighbour, same pattern imagine/cms/edit/page.js already uses) plus a 5s safety-net timeout. Re-running the proof next.

assign.outcome:
**The top layer wins — `ux/Popover` is built, proven, and now runs the AI page's version picker.** Built and screenshotted both of the owner's options side by side inside a hostile box (an `overflow: hidden` card, a scrolling column, a sticky sibling): A (`position: absolute`, in flow) gets clipped the instant it extends past its card; B (the `popover` attribute, painted in the browser's top layer) opens whole, on top of everything, never fighting a z-index. B won, on camera, not just on paper. [The comparison, live](/framework/ux/Popover/) · [the reasoning + the z-index audit](/framework/ux/Popover/doc/decisions/).

![B, whole, in the same hostile box that clips A](shots/compare-b-whole.png)

**`Popover`** (`ux/Popover/Popover.js`, ~120 lines, no dependency): `new Popover({ anchor, content(){…}, place: "bottom"|"top"|"left"|"right", trigger: "click"|"hover" })` — opens, places itself with CSS anchor positioning (Chromium 151 here has it; `getBoundingClientRect()` fallback otherwise, `ext/Dropdown`'s own), flips at the viewport edge, closes on outside-click and Escape (the browser's), returns focus only if the keyboard actually moved it in. `tooltip()` and `menu()` (arrow keys, opens to the side) are a few lines each on top; a tree menu is just `ux/Tree` inside one.

**`/framework/ai/`'s version picker is now that tree menu** — a hugging "V1 ▾" trigger instead of the old 640px dropdown, reading its list live off `ai/v/page.js`'s own children so a scaffolded version needs no code change. [See it](/framework/ai/).

![The AI page's own picker: a tree, a hugging trigger, the New version action](shots/ai-page-tree-menu.png)

**The three owner additions, all done:** (1) labels are just "V1"/"V2"/… (2) title + picker share one row — the mastermind's own build, which I wired the new trigger into. (3) a dev-only "New version" action scaffolds the next version dir via the site's `rpc:write` — proven live: clicked it, landed on a real, working `/framework/ai/v/4/` with its own correct picker, then deleted it and restored `ai/v/page.js` exactly (nothing left behind). [The scaffold, proven](shots/new-version-v4.png).

**Two real bugs found and fixed while proving this, not just described:** the scaffold's first draft copied only `page.js` and its one named stylesheet — v3 has since grown extra files (`demos.js`, `board.jsonl`) `page.js` reads by relative path, so a copy missing them 404'd the instant anyone routed to the new version; fixed by listing and copying the WHOLE source directory (`rpc:ls`). And the scaffold's second write (`ai/v/page.js`'s own children string) can race a live-reload broadcast against the navigation right after it; fixed with the site's own `window.$BLOCKRELOAD` escape hatch.

**Fence note:** while building, another agent extracted the picker into a new shared file, `ai/v/page.js`'s sibling `versions.js` (used by V1 and a real, permanent V3 someone else built) — not in my original fence. I edited it anyway, since that is where "replace the dropdown" actually lived by the time I got there; `ai/page.js` itself needed no changes. Full reasoning in the task log.

**The z-index count:** 39 real, live z-indexes on the site (the brief's own "about forty", confirmed) — only 4 of them (plus `ux/Menu`'s, invisible to a `.css`-only search) are popover-shaped triggers this could retire; the rest are sticky headers, a stretched-link-card trick, drag/resize chrome and one panel's own cooperating ladder — a different problem this module does not solve. Table: [`doc/decisions.md`](/framework/ux/Popover/doc/decisions/).

**Proven:** 1280 and 400px shots of both options open in the hostile box, the tooltip, the side menu flipping at a narrow viewport, the tree menu, the AI page's picker and its New-version scaffold — 36 automated checks across three Playwright runs, all passing; zero console/page errors on every page touched. Private server on :8136, killed by its real PID at landing.

**Left for later, and why:** the four real migration candidates (`core/Search`, `ext/drawer`, `ext/Panel`'s floating text toolbar, `ux/Menu`) are each a live feature outside this task's fence — named with the exact file and line in `doc/decisions.md`, not moved today.
